👨‍⚕️ Hi, I'm Dr James O'Donovan. I hold a medical degree (MBBS), Masters Degree (MRes) in Ageing and Health, PhD (DPhil) in Digital Education and MBA. 

📚 My goal is to make health topics easy to understand and accessible!

⏰ I release new videos every Wednesday & Sunday.

 Please subscribe & join our community of likeminded learners. 

⚠️ Disclaimer: Information on this channel is intended as a free open-access educational resource and not as clinical advice. Doctor O'Donovan Medical Education Ltd. can not provide individual advice. All information is accurate to the best of my knowledge at the time of publication. Medical education videos on Doctor O'Donovan Medical Education Ltd. are not a substitute for professional professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. NEVER ignore professional medical advice because of something you have heard here. ALWAYS consult your OWN health provider.

Collaboration enquires: https://www.doctorodonovan.com/collaborate

UK GMC Number: 7436647
